module.title: Inbox
module.subtitle: Email triage
module.description: Triage incoming studio email: classify, suggest an action and prepare replies before anyone answers.

page.title: Email triage
page.subtitle: Messages captured from the connected inboxes, classified and waiting for review.

settings.title: Connected inboxes
settings.subtitle: Each inbox is read through a Lovable-managed Gmail connector. Tokens are never stored in the database — only the name of the connector secret.
settings.securityNote: Credentials live as environment secrets managed by Lovable. This screen stores only the inbox address and which connector secret to use.
settings.label: Label
settings.secretHint: Name of the environment variable holding the connector key (e.g. GOOGLE_MAIL_API_KEY_2).
settings.connectorTitle: How to connect a second inbox
settings.connectorSteps: Ask Lovable to link a second Gmail connector for this inbox. Once linked, its key is available as a new environment secret — enter that secret's name below.
settings.adminOnly: Only administrators can manage connected inboxes.

queue.emptySub: Every captured message has been triaged.
queue.loadError: Could not load the review queue.
queue.draftHint: Edit the text before sending — the sent version is stored back on the message.
queue.noDraft: No draft reply was prepared for this message.
queue.actionFailed: Action failed — the message stays in the queue
queue.actionsNote: Approve & send and Archive write to Gmail. Label only and Reject leave the mailbox untouched.
